accepted.inventory: Green Mountain complete current site portfolio
accepted.reuse: Public copyrighted operator pages; bounded factual extraction only. No open licence is asserted, source HTML is not redistributed and sensitive location/access details are excluded.
accepted.originals: Eight factual official HTML originals total 1,066,336 bytes and have individual SHA-256 checksums in sources.json. A separate 121,672-byte privacy-policy capture supported rights review but is not a factual source.

deferred.candidate: Green Mountain exact building and phase identities
deferred.reason: Current pages disclose building counts and aggregate campus facts but not enough exact building identities and parent-child bindings to create reviewable child records. Continue only from official building/phase or permit evidence.

quarantined.reason: The current page reports a 54 MW power card and a parenthetical 80 MW-in-2026 statement without identifying either as IT, grid or total facility demand. Both remain dated observations and normalized scalars remain null.

normalization_notes: The complete current Green Mountain portfolio is processed at offset seven: five operational sites and two under construction.

SVG-Rennesøy is an independent facility. TEL-Rjukan, OSL-Enebakk, OSL-Hamar, LON-East, FRA-Mainz and SVG-Undheim are multi-building campus aggregates and remain excluded from capacity totals under every filter.

Only explicit IT statements are normalized: SVG-Rennesøy 25 MW design maximum and the four campus aggregates TEL-Rjukan 50 MW, OSL-Enebakk 75 MW, OSL-Hamar 150 MW and SVG-Undheim 80 MW. Campus values remain excluded from totals.

LON-East secured power, new capacity and maximum cooling capacity remain separate observations. FRA-Mainz current/future power statements remain observation-only. SVG-Undheim total-site capacity is not substituted for IT capacity.
OSL-Hamar's 90 MW completed operating portion remains an observation distinct from its 150 MW campus total. TEL-Rjukan retains its 1.08–1.20 PUE range rather than a scalar.
Campus footprint, IT space, existing space and construction space retain their exact source boundaries. No area is used to infer capacity.
Operator Tier and ISO claims remain observations and are not normalized as issuer-registry certifications. No building child, deployment or commissioning date is inferred.
All prior reuse holds and quarantines remain in force; this run introduced no new reuse restriction.
